description: Source code for FreeType library's PFR-specific data access functions, including metrics, kerning, and advance retrieval.

methods.name: ft_pfr_check
methods.description: Checks if the given face supports PFR metrics service.

methods.name: FT_Get_PFR_Metrics
methods.description: Retrieves PFR-specific font metrics, or defaults if not available.

methods.name: FT_Get_PFR_Kerning
methods.description: Retrieves kerning information for PFR fonts.

methods.name: FT_Get_PFR_Advance
methods.description: Retrieves advance width for PFR fonts.
